row.prompt: How do lightbulbs work?

row.prompt: What is the purpose of the small pocket on jeans?

row.prompt: What are the main components of a bicycle? How do they work together?

row.prompt: Can you explain in simple terms how a dishwasher works? Pretend you are talking to somebody who has never seen one.

row.prompt: Can you explain in simple terms how a vacuum cleaner works? Pretend you are talking to somebody who has never seen one.

row.prompt: Can you explain how to make a simple salad dressing?

row.prompt: How many days can you keep fish in the fridge before it's dangerous to eat?

row.raw_text: गाड़ी मँगा ज्वो मुख्य हिस्सा व्हंन्दा छिन् वेमाँ सबसे पेलि व्होन्दु इंजन, गाड़ी चलोंणा खातिर सख्ती बणोंदु च् यो ।फिर व्हनु च् ट्रांसमेशन -गियर बदल्ना खातिर व्हनु च् यो। फिर व्हनु च् चैजेज जेते ब्वोलदिन गाड्यू ढाँचा ।फिर व्हंदा छिन् पहिया -टायर जेते ब्वल्दा छिन् चलौंडा़ खातिर व्हंदु च्। फिर व्हंदु ब्रेक गाड़ी रुकोंणा खातिर व्हंदु च्। फिर बैटरी व्हंदि चि जो बिजली आपूर्ति द्ंयोदी च् गाड़ी माँ ।

row.prompt: What are some foods that are really simple and you enjoy a lot?
